explication: AMPopTip is an iOS popover library: an app configures and shows a PopTip, which positions and draws a directional bubble, presents it with animation, and supports updates and dismissal. The README also documents text, custom UIKit views, SwiftUI views, masks, gesture callbacks, and animation customization; these capabilities are implemented through the main PopTip API. Relationships involving unsampled portions of that file are omitted rather than inferred.
